nodes.label: Coherence
nodes.intent: The repository-level reading surface: configuration, package contract, generated maps, and the authored explanation of why the harness exists.

nodes.label: Harness core
nodes.intent: Builds the source/spec graph, evaluates declared claims, renders reading surfaces, and records the decisions and observations that must survive an agent's context window.

nodes.label: Source adapters
nodes.intent: Translate language syntax and platform configuration into the common graph vocabulary consumed by the harness core.

nodes.label: Executable contracts
nodes.intent: Exercises the harness through focused unit contracts and end-to-end fixtures built from the same public data shapes that consuming repositories use.
